inform.para: The direct view of passenger cabin by flight attendants pertains to direct visual contact between the flight attendants and the passenger cabin. It is considered that at least 80 % of the total number of passenger seats installed, 50 % of the seats in each divided zone, should be visible to flight attendants.

procitem.title: Procedure to be Developed in the Operator's MEL

inform.para: Alternate procedures must be established before departure to ensure that at least 80 % of the total number of passenger seats installed and 50 % of the seats in each divided zone, is visible to flight attendants.
